WITH DISTINCT_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_column} AS PARTITION_VAL
    FROM
        @{pipeline().parameters.p_src_schema}.@{pipeline().parameters.p_src_table}
),

VALID_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT
        PARTITION_VAL
    FROM DISTINCT_PARTITION
    WHERE
        PARTITION_VAL IS NOT NULL
        AND REGEXP_LIKE(
            PARTITION_VAL,
            '^[0-9]{6}$'
        )
        AND SUBSTR(
            PARTITION_VAL,
            5,
            2
        ) BETWEEN '01' AND '12'
        AND
        (
            '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_from}' = ''
            OR PARTITION_VAL >= '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_from}'
        )
        AND
        (
            '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_to}' = ''
            OR PARTITION_VAL <= '@{pipeline().parameters.p_partition_to}'
        )
),

INVALID_EXISTS AS
(
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM DISTINCT_PARTITION
                WHERE
                        PARTITION_VAL IS NULL
                    OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(
                        PARTITION_VAL,
                        '^[0-9]{6}$'
                    )
                    OR SUBSTR(
                        PARTITION_VAL,
                        5,
                        2
                    ) NOT BETWEEN '01' AND '12'
            )
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS INVALID_YN
    FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
)

SELECT 
    LISTAGG(
        '"' || PARTITION_ID || '"',
        ','
    ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY PARTITION_ID) AS partition_list  
FROM (  
    SELECT
        PARTITION_VAL AS PARTITION_ID
    FROM VALID_PARTITION

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'INVALID' AS PARTITION_ID
    FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
    WHERE
        (
            SELECT INVALID_YN
            FROM INVALID_EXISTS
        ) = 1
) RT
WITH UR;

@concat(
'WITH RAW_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ',
        if(
            equals(
                toLower(trim(pipeline().parameters.p_partition_data_type)),
                'string'
            ),
            concat(
                'TRIM(CAST(',
                pipeline().parameters.p_partition_column,
                ' AS VARCHAR(100)))'
            ),
            pipeline().parameters.p_partition_column
        ),
        ' AS RAW_VAL
    FROM ',
        if(
            empty(pipeline().parameters.p_cdc_tgt_sceham_nm),
            pipeline().parameters.p_src_schema,
            pipeline().parameters.p_cdc_tgt_sceham_nm
        ),
        '.',
        pipeline().parameters.p_src_table,
'
),

DISTINCT_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT
        ',
        if(
            equals(
                toLower(trim(pipeline().parameters.p_partition_data_type)),
                'string'
            ),

            if(
                equals(
                    toLower(trim(pipeline().parameters.p_partition_range)),
                    'monthly'
                ),

                '
                RAW_VAL AS PARTITION_VAL,

                CASE
                    WHEN RAW_VAL IS NOT NULL
                     AND REGEXP_LIKE(
                            RAW_VAL,
                            ''^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$''
                         )
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS VALID_YN
                ',

                '
                LEFT(
                    RAW_VAL,
                    4
                ) AS PARTITION_VAL,

                CASE
                    WHEN RAW_VAL IS NOT NULL
                     AND
                     (
                         REGEXP_LIKE(
                             RAW_VAL,
                             ''^[0-9]{4}$''
                         )

                         OR

                         REGEXP_LIKE(
                             RAW_VAL,
                             ''^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$''
                         )
                     )
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS VALID_YN
                '
            ),

            concat(
                '
                VARCHAR_FORMAT(
                    RAW_VAL,
                    ''',
                    if(
                        equals(
                            toLower(trim(pipeline().parameters.p_partition_range)),
                            'monthly'
                        ),
                        'YYYYMM',
                        'YYYY'
                    ),
                    '''
                ) AS PARTITION_VAL,

                CASE
                    WHEN RAW_VAL IS NULL
                    THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END AS VALID_YN
                '
            )
        ),
'
    FROM RAW_PARTITION
),

VALID_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        PARTITION_VAL
    FROM DISTINCT_PARTITION
    WHERE
        VALID_YN = 1

        AND
        (
            ''',
            pipeline().parameters.p_partition_from,
            ''' = ''''

            OR PARTITION_VAL >= ',
            if(
                equals(
                    toLower(trim(pipeline().parameters.p_partition_range)),
                    'yearly'
                ),
                concat(
                    'LEFT(''',
                    pipeline().parameters.p_partition_from,
                    ''', 4)'
                ),
                concat(
                    '''',
                    pipeline().parameters.p_partition_from,
                    ''''
                )
            ),
'
        )

        AND
        (
            ''',
            pipeline().parameters.p_partition_to,
            ''' = ''''

            OR PARTITION_VAL <= ',
            if(
                equals(
                    toLower(trim(pipeline().parameters.p_partition_range)),
                    'yearly'
                ),
                concat(
                    'LEFT(''',
                    pipeline().parameters.p_partition_to,
                    ''', 4)'
                ),
                concat(
                    '''',
                    pipeline().parameters.p_partition_to,
                    ''''
                )
            ),
'
        )
),

RESULT_PARTITION AS
(
    SELECT
        PARTITION_VAL AS PARTITION_ID
    FROM VALID_PARTITION

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ''INVALID'' AS PARTITION_ID
    FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
    WHERE EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM DISTINCT_PARTITION
        WHERE VALID_YN = 0
    )
)

SELECT
    LISTAGG(
        ''"'' || PARTITION_ID || ''"'',
        '',''
    ) WITHIN GROUP
    (
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN PARTITION_ID = ''INVALID''
                THEN 2
                ELSE 1
            END,
            PARTITION_ID
    ) AS partition_list
FROM RESULT_PARTITION
WITH UR'
)
